findings.passage: Three significant bills, namely HB 1207, 974, and SB 189 successfully made it to the governor's desk. These bills require election workers to be citizens, allow candidates to verify ballot accuracy, set standards for poll watchers, protect election workers, require posting of scanned paper ballots, expand risk-limiting audits, remove the Secretary of State from the state elections board, and establish residency requirements for elections.
findings.note: From the Election Integrity section of his campaign site, written after the 2024 session. Describes three 2024 election bills as election integrity measures. It does not mention voter ID or proof of citizenship to vote. The page is undated; the year is from its text about the recent session.

findings.passage: These legislators hope that through such an inspection they can provide reassurance that every legal vote is accounted for properly after receiving complaints regarding the distrust of the Dominion voting machines in Cherokee County.
findings.note: Joint press release issued in the names of three Cherokee County legislators, including then Representative-elect Thomas, calling for a public mock election on county voting machines. It is about voting machines, not voter ID.
